title: Pure Time Thief
summary: Pure Time Thief control build, focusing on psychic thieves and temporal machines that steal cards from the opponent's Deck and GY to fuel Rank 4 Xyz disruptions. The archetype manipulates attached materials to banish itself to dodge removal, draw cards, and spin opposing threats without destruction.

summary.title: Starters
points: Time Thief Regulator tributes itself while you control no other monsters to Special Summon two different Time Thief monsters directly from your Deck.
Time Thief Winder Special Summons itself from the hand by detaching an Xyz material from any Xyz Monster you control, searching any Time Thief card upon summon.
Time Thief Adjuster Special Summons itself from the hand when another Time Thief monster is Normal or Special Summoned, and sends a Time Thief card from Deck to GY on summon.
Time Thief Startup Special Summons a Time Thief monster from your hand and can banish itself from the GY to attach 3 different card types from the GY to a Time Thief Xyz Monster.

summary.title: Opening: Time Thief Regulator
steps: Normal Summon Time Thief Regulator while controlling no other monsters.
Tribute Regulator to activate its effect, Special Summoning Time Thief Winder and Time Thief Bezel Ship from your Deck.
Time Thief Winder triggers on Special Summon, adding Time Thief Retrograde (or Time Thief Flyback) from your Deck to your hand.
Overlay Winder and Bezel Ship to Xyz Summon Time Thief Redoer.
Set Time Thief Retrograde and pass turn, prepared to steal the top card of the opponent's Deck during their Standby Phase.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Time Thief Redoer attaches the top card of the opponent's Deck to itself as material during each Standby Phase, and detaches materials as a Quick Effect to draw 1 card (Spell), spin 1 face-up card to the top of the Deck (Trap), or banish itself until the End Phase to dodge removal (Monster).
Time Thief Perpetua detaches 1 material during the Standby Phase to revive a Time Thief monster, and as a Quick Effect attaches a Time Thief card from the Deck to any Xyz Monster you control.

Time Thief Double Barrel detaches up to 3 materials in response to opponent activations to boost its ATK (Monster), negate an effect monster (Spell), or take control of an opponent's monster until the End Phase (Trap).
Time Thief Bezel Ship detaches a material from a Time Thief Xyz to revive itself from the GY, extending into Perpetua or Double Barrel.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Time Thief Retrograde negates the activation of an opponent's Spell or Trap Card while you control a Time Thief Xyz Monster and attaches that negated card directly to your Xyz as material.
Time Thief Flyback attaches a Time Thief card from your Deck to a Time Thief Xyz, or banishes itself from the GY to attach a card from the opponent's GY.

Time Thief Power Reserve summons itself as a Level 4 Machine Trap Monster, tutors an additional Machine Time Thief from Deck or GY, and can banish itself from the GY while you control an Xyz with both a Spell and a Trap attached to banish an opponent's card.
Time Thief Hack grants targeting and destruction protection to newly summoned Xyz Monsters and boosts their ATK per attached material.

main: Time Thief Winder
Starter: searches any Time Thief card; summons itself by detaching a material.
Time Thief Regulator
Tributes itself for two Time Thief monsters from the Deck.
Time Thief Adjuster
Summons itself after a Time Thief summon; mills a Time Thief card.
Time Thief Bezel Ship
Attaches a card from their GY; revives by detaching a material.
Time Thief Temporwhal
Banishes their monster until the End Phase; revives itself.
Time Thief Chronocorder
Reflects battle damage; revives when an Xyz leaves the field.
Time Thief Startup
Quick-Play: summons a Time Thief; attaches a Monster, Spell and Trap from the GY.
Time Thief Hack
Protects new Xyz Monsters; pumps an Xyz to attack directly.
Time Thief Flyback
Attaches a Time Thief card from the Deck, or a card from their GY.
Time Thief Retrograde
Counter Trap: negates a Spell/Trap and attaches it.
Time Thief Power Reserve
Newest Trap Monster: summons a Machine Time Thief; banishes a card from the GY.
